description: Remove members inactive for a number of days who hold no roles. Needs Kick Members and Manage Server, or Administrator where the owner has made pruning admin-only. Safe to call directly: the first call counts who would go using Discord's own preview and returns a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token prunes for real.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

reason.description: The reason recorded in the server's audit log.

name: prune_members
title: Prune members
